description: Search the startup database with any combination of filters: name, sector, country, city radius, founded date, team size, the latest funding round (round_series, raised_after), total funding, valuation, investors (backed_by), StartupHub score, Agent Readiness score, tech stack, website state, stealth status and known founder emails. Each result includes the latest round (last_round_series, last_round_date), sectors, HQ, founded date and score; paid plans add funding totals, headcount and more. Example: round_series=Seed, raised_after=2026-10-01, sort=last_round_date.desc for companies that just raised a seed round. Returns up to 100 per call (1 db credit); page with offset. Pairs with list_startup_team and discover_email to turn each result into a contactable lead. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

a11y.description: Comma-separated accessibility overlays: userway, accessibe, audioeye; matches any of them.

affiliate_program.description: Comma-separated affiliate platforms: partnerstack, rewardful, tolt, firstpromoter, impact; matches any of them.

agent_readiness_grade.description: Comma-separated Agent Readiness grades: A+, A, B, C, D, F; matches any of them.

backed_by.description: Comma-separated investors, by StartupHub slug or exact name, e.g. "sequoia-capital,Y Combinator"; matches any of them.

booking.description: Comma-separated booking widgets: calendly, calcom, savvycal, chilipiper; matches any of them.

cdn.description: Comma-separated CDNs: cloudflare, vercel, cloudfront, fastly, netlify; matches any of them.

compliance.description: Comma-separated compliance claims found on the site: soc2, hipaa, iso27001, gdpr, ccpa, pci_dss, fedramp; matches any of them.

cookie_consent.description: Comma-separated cookie consent vendors: onetrust, cookiebot, osano, termly; matches any of them.

country.description: Comma-separated countries; matches any of them. Accepts names or ISO codes; "US", "USA" and "United States" are the same.

domain_tld.description: Comma-separated domain endings, e.g. "ai,io"; matches any of them.

email_marketing.description: Comma-separated email marketing tools: klaviyo, mailchimp, hubspot_forms, customer_io, loops; matches any of them.

email_provider.description: Comma-separated email providers: google_workspace, m365, zoho, proton, proofpoint, mimecast, self_hosted, gateway; matches any of them.

employees_max.description: Maximum employee count (inclusive). Use 10 for tiny teams.

founded_after.description: Founded on or after this date: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

founded_before.description: Founded on or before this date: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

has_affiliate_program.description: 'true' returns only companies running an affiliate program.

has_founders.description: 'true' returns only companies with known founders, ready for list_startup_team.

has_known_emails.description: 'true' returns only companies with at least one verified founder or team email. Pro Lite and up; Pro Lite sees redacted addresses, Pro sees them in full.

has_website.description: 'true' returns only companies with a website on file.

hiring.description: 'true' returns only companies with open roles right now.

hiring_platform.description: Comma-separated hiring platforms: greenhouse, lever, ashby, workable, teamtailor; matches any of them.

hosting.description: Comma-separated hosting providers: aws, azure, gcp, vercel, render, netlify, hetzner, digitalocean; matches any of them.

ma_status.description: Comma-separated exit states: acquired, public, merged, made_acquisitions; matches any of them.

mentioned_since.description: Covered in StartupHub news on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

min_agent_readiness.description: Minimum Agent Readiness score (0-100): how well AI agents can use the company website.

min_linkedin_followers.description: Minimum LinkedIn followers, a brand-size proxy when headcount is unknown.

min_reddit_reviews.description: Minimum number of classified Reddit reviews.

min_reddit_sentiment.description: Minimum Reddit sentiment, -100 to 100. Pair with min_reddit_reviews.

min_score.description: Minimum StartupHub score (0-100). 70+ is roughly the top 1.5%.

min_valuation.description: Minimum latest valuation, USD. 1000000000 for unicorns.

near.description: HQ within a radius: "lat,lng,radius_km", radius capped at 500 km. Example "51.507,-0.128,25" for central London.

offset.description: Skip this many results, to page past the first 100.

payment.description: Comma-separated payment providers: stripe, paddle, lemonsqueezy, paypal, klarna, apple_pay; matches any of them.

q.description: Search text, matched against the name and one-liner.

raised_after.description: Most recent funding round announced on or after this date: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

raised_before.description: Most recent funding round announced on or before this date.

round_series.description: Comma-separated stages of the most recent funding round; matches any of them. Values: Angel, Pre-Seed, Seed, Pre-Series A, Series A to Series H, Growth, Debt, Grant, Strategic, IPO. Pair with raised_after for "just raised a seed round".

sector.description: Comma-separated sector names, e.g. "Fintech,Cybersecurity"; matches any of them. Exact sector names as shown on profiles.

slugs.description: Comma-separated StartupHub slugs, to fetch known companies in one call; matches any of them.

sort.description: '<column>.<asc|desc>'. Columns: total_score, last_round_date, total_funding, latest_valuation, founded_date, employee_count, linkedin_followers, agent_readiness_score, trending_score_7d, current_revenue, revenue_multiple, revenue_per_employee, funding_efficiency. Default total_score.desc.

status_page.description: Comma-separated status page vendors: statuspage, instatus, betterstack; matches any of them.

stealth.description: 'true' = stealth only, 'false' = exclude stealth. Stealth rows need Pro Lite or higher.

trending.description: 'true' returns companies getting attention on StartupHub this week.

website_status.description: Comma-separated website states: active, dead, parked; matches any of them.

name: search_startups
title: Search startups
